comments.body: Thanks. `isSensitiveName` now ranges over `strings.SplitSeq(...)` (`plugin.go`, the line `modernize` flagged), in a new commit on top of the branch. With the change, `modernize ./internal/plugins/...` exits 0, and `gofmt`, `go vet` and `go test ./internal/plugins/...` pass. The Go Build failure in the 19:30 and 19:35 runs was that `modernize` step, so it should be green now.
